name: B10-0537/2026 (Renew) – Condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the condemnation of pro-democracy activist and former lawmaker Au Kam San in Macao
part_text:
The European Parliament strongly criticises the conviction of Au Kam San, a former lawmaker and European Union citizen in Macao, who was sentenced to 12 years and six months in prison. It calls for his release and for the release of other political prisoners in Macao and Hong Kong. It also asks the European Union to put pressure on Macao, including by threatening to end a 1992 trade agreement. This is a statement of the Parliament's position; it does not itself change any law.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. The Parliament is asking the European Commission and Council to act.
- **Who it affects:** Au Kam San, Macao authorities, and European Union relations with Macao and China.
- **What happens next:** The Commission and Council decide whether to make the joint committee conditional on his release, or to end the 1992 trade agreement.
